title: Record a lab order
summary: Enter a job for the lab step by step: patient, services with teeth, laboratory and review; it can be sent while creating it.

inputs.send_due_date: Expected delivery date if sent now (YYYY-MM-DD)

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: Patient
steps.details: Who the job is for. From the patient’s record it comes preselected.

steps.title: Doctor
steps.details: Who requested the job. They get the order’s alerts. If you are a doctor, you come preselected.

steps.title: Service
steps.details: Pick the job from the list. You can add several. The quantity is next to the name, and it is almost always one.

steps.title: Teeth
steps.details: The teeth for that service: type them or tap them on the chart next to it. The order’s teeth are all its services’ teeth combined.

steps.title: Service note
steps.details: Shade, material or any instruction for the lab.

steps.title: Continue
steps.details: Goes to the lab. At least one service is needed.

steps.title: Lab
steps.details: If only one lab does that job, it comes preselected. Otherwise click one of the suggestions, or leave it for when you send it.

steps.title: Continue
steps.details: Goes to review the order before creating it.

steps.title: Review the order
steps.details: Patient, job and lab. Edit takes you back to that step without losing anything.

steps.title: Send it now?
steps.details: Save to send later keeps it in the first stage. Send now creates it and moves it to the next stage, and asks for the due date.

steps.title: Expected delivery
steps.details: The one the lab promised. From the next day, if it has not arrived, the order shows as overdue.

steps.title: Attachments
steps.details: Photos, PDFs or 3D scans for the lab. They upload when the order is created.

steps.title: Urgent
steps.details: If you mark it, it shows first in the list, on the board and in the patient’s record.

steps.title: Create the order
steps.details: Without sending it, it stays in the first stage. If you chose to send it now, it moves to the next stage with the lab and the date.
